Autocrafting needs a brain, and the §6Crafting CPU §fit is. Build a multiblock from Crafting Units, Co-Processors, and Crafting Storage blocks in a 3x3x3 cube.

Each Crafting Unit core manages one crafting job. Co-Processors add parallel job slots. Crafting Storage provides buffer space for ingredients during complex recipes.

Start with a single Crafting Unit for testing. Expand to a full 3x3x3 once you need more storage or parallel processing. Place a Crafting Monitor on the structure to see job progress.

Craft the Crafting Unit core from Iron, a Calculation Processor, Fluix Cables, and a Logic Processor.

§ePS:§f Multiple CPUs can run independent jobs simultaneously. Just make sure your Molecular Assemblers have enough channels.
